visibility.processHint: Hide Windows components and processes on the additional hide list, keeping the always-show list. Only changes the displayed list.
visibility.networkHint: Hide connections owned by system processes and entries with no owning process (PID 0). Only changes the displayed list.
visibility.description: System processes are identified from Windows component information. Both pages share these rules and save their hiding switches separately.
visibility.keepHint: Keep these programs visible, including system processes. This list takes priority over additional hiding.
visibility.hideHint: Hide these programs when hiding is enabled. Leave empty to hide system processes only.
visibility.namesHint: Enter executable names separated by commas or semicolons, up to 128 per list. Names are case-insensitive.
visibility.invalid: Enter valid executable names without paths or wildcards, up to 128 per list.
visibility.empty: No items match the current filters.

identityPending: Confirming the process identity. Try again shortly.
countersPending: Collecting resource counters for this process.
refreshPending: Updating process data. Showing the last successfully collected reading.

diskUnavailable.pending: No disk reading yet. A process that has only just appeared gets one at the next refresh.
diskUnavailable.enable: No disk reading. Windows doesn't provide these counters directly, so they come from the privileged service, which can be enabled in Settings.
diskUnavailable.update: No disk reading. The privileged service version doesn't match Argus; update the service in Settings.
diskUnavailable.start: No disk reading. The privileged service is stopped; it can be started in Settings.
diskUnavailable.service: No disk reading. Couldn't read it from the privileged service; check the service status in Settings.
diskUnavailable.unavailable: No disk reading. Per-process disk counters can't be read right now.

filtered: The list is filtered by the search

name.label: Name
name.title: App name or file description; secondary text shows the executable name.

mem.label: Memory
mem.title: Private working set: physical memory used by this process alone

diskRead.label: Disk read
diskRead.title: Disk bytes read per second; excludes network and other device I/O

diskWrite.label: Disk write
diskWrite.title: Disk bytes written per second; excludes network and other device I/O

io.label: I/O
io.title: All read, write and other I/O, including files, network and devices

gpu.label: GPU
gpu.title: Share of time the process uses its busiest GPU engine

net.label: Network
net.title: Bytes sent and received per second

ppid.label: Parent PID
ppid.title: Parent process ID recorded at creation.

path.label: Image path
path.title: Full path of the process executable.

description.label: Description
description.title: Executable file description or packaged app name.

company.label: Company
company.title: Company name from the executable version information.

sessionId.label: Session ID
sessionId.title: Windows session that contains the process.

createTime.label: Start time
createTime.title: Process creation time in the local time zone.

suspended.label: Suspended
suspended.title: All threads of the process are waiting in the suspended state.

efficiency.label: Efficiency mode
efficiency.title: EcoQoS power efficiency state of the process.

cpuTime.label: CPU time
cpuTime.title: Accumulated user and kernel CPU time; groups show the member total.

cpuUserTime.label: User CPU time
cpuUserTime.title: Accumulated CPU time spent in user mode.

cpuKernelTime.label: Kernel CPU time
cpuKernelTime.title: Accumulated CPU time spent in kernel mode.

basePriority.label: Base priority
basePriority.title: Numeric process base priority reported by Windows.

workingSet.label: Working set
workingSet.title: Resident physical memory, including shared pages. Groups sum member working sets.

peakWorkingSet.label: Peak working set
peakWorkingSet.title: Peak working set of one process since startup. Expand an app group to view its processes.

commit.label: Commit size
commit.title: Private committed memory of the process.

virtualSize.label: Virtual address space
virtualSize.title: Reserved and committed address ranges of one process. Commit size shows committed private memory.

pageFaults.label: Page faults
pageFaults.title: Accumulated page faults, including soft and hard faults.

ioRead.label: I/O read
ioRead.title: I/O bytes read per second, including files, network and devices.

ioWrite.label: I/O write
ioWrite.title: I/O bytes written per second, including files, network and devices.

ioOther.label: Other I/O
ioOther.title: Bytes transferred per second by other I/O operations.

ioReadTotal.label: Total I/O read
ioReadTotal.title: Total I/O bytes read over the process lifetime.

ioWriteTotal.label: Total I/O write
ioWriteTotal.title: Total I/O bytes written over the process lifetime.

ioOtherTotal.label: Total other I/O
ioOtherTotal.title: Total bytes transferred by other I/O over the process lifetime.

netReceived.label: Network receive
netReceived.title: Network traffic received by the process per second.

netSent.label: Network send
netSent.title: Network traffic sent by the process per second.

gpuEngine.label: GPU engine
gpuEngine.title: The busiest GPU engine of the process.

gpuDedicated.label: Dedicated GPU memory
gpuDedicated.title: Current resident dedicated GPU memory attributed to the process. Groups sum member counters.

gpuShared.label: Shared GPU memory
gpuShared.title: Current resident shared GPU memory attributed to the process. Groups sum member counters.

sectionSearching: While searching, every match shows; clear the search to collapse groups

columns.description: Check the columns to show. Drag them in the list on the right, or drag column headers, to change their order.
columns.networkUnavailable: Selected network columns appear when traffic data is available.
columns.virtualAliases: virtual memory virtual bytes address reservation
